name: hud_stack_rival_caretaker_mark
description: A caretaker's Ready mark is lit only where it counts toward a present player's call (M8, design 2.7: in a wave a mark 'is a call for the next wave'; SimWaves._all_ready): racing the caretaker, the rival's caretaker Lookout plays a hollow nobody is present at, where it calls only as its plan says (its stack list is wave 5), so through the rival's wave 1 its plate shows the mark unlit, not 'caretaker ready'. In High Water beside me a caretaker partner counts as Ready, so in a wave that may stack its mark is lit, and mine is not until I call.

steps.assert: scene.sim.hollows[1].wave == 1 and not scene.sim.seat(2).ready and scene.sim.can_stack(1)
steps.msg: the rival's wave 1 walks, a call could be taken there, and its caretaker has said none
its plate shows the mark, unlit: no call stands
beside me a caretaker partner counts as Ready: its mark lit, mine not
